thread:
camille: Heads up — need to finalize the Dedicated capacity PRD acceptance criteria for Q2 launch. HealthCorp + FinServ pilots expect clear SLOs, autoscale rules, and rollback playbook.

arjun: Good. Can we split must-haves vs nice-to-haves? I can draft an SLO table and throughput targets.

camille: Must-haves: p95 gen latency <= 250ms at 512 tokens (baseline), 99.95% regional uptime SLA, autoscale to cover 2x baseline burst within 60s. Nice-to-have: per-route token cost < $0.0009 and per-route canary granularity.

maria: Edge cases to call out: KV cache cold-starts, long sequence (>2048) tail latency spikes, quantized fallback hallucination risk. We should set regression tolerances for quality — e.g., acceptability drop <= 1% on eval set or human-checked customer prompts.

arjun: Draft acceptance criteria proposal:
- Latency SLOs: p95 <= 250ms @ 512 tokens, p99 <= 650ms.
- Throughput sizing: baseline sustained 2000 req/min with avg 256 tokens -> ~8.5k tokens/s sustained. We'll size capacity for 1.5x baseline steady then autoscale for bursts.
- Autoscale: add nodes when GPU util > 70% for 15s, target scale-up to hit 2x baseline within 60s. Scale-down after 5m under 35%.

jen: Autoscale policy nit: use util + queue latency signal to avoid flapping. Also require a cooldown window and cap concurrency per-GPU. Burst capacity should be reservable: configable 2x headroom for critical customers for short bursts.

samir: Fallback strategy: if primary model error rate > 1% over 1 minute or p95 breach > 20% from baseline, route to a quantized smaller variant and mark request with "fallback=true" header. Cold-start for fallback must be < 20s.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist created (DED-PRD-432). Attachments: perf-bench v2, canary playbook draft.

camille: Rollout gating: canary 5% traffic for 30m. Automated rollback if p95 > 300ms or error rate > 0.5% in canary window. Manual review required if quality regression > 0.5% on customer evals.

maria: For noisy neighbor / multi-tenant cases we need per-tenant concurrency limits and token buckets. If a tenant exceeds its burst, apply 429 with Retry-After and route to soft-throttle mode. Include test scenarios for token-exhaustion.

arjun: Concrete numbers to add to the PRD:
- Target p95 <= 250ms @ 512 toks; p99 <= 650ms.
- Baseline throughput: 8500 toks/s sustained.
- Autoscale target: support up to 8x baseline capacity total; respond to 2x short bursts within 60s.
- Canary: 5% traffic for 30m, rollback if p95>300ms OR errors>0.5% OR quality delta > 1% on eval set.

camille: Acceptance probes: synthetic workload with 60/40 short/long requests + 1% adversarial prompts. Failing criteria = any probe run with p95/SLA breach or error spikes.

jen: Add runbook snippets in PRD: manual scale (CLI + console), rollback steps, how to flip feature flag to fall back to Hosted API, and escalation path with oncall. Include `kubectl`/deploy examples and link to incident runbook.

samir: Billing guardrail: ability to cap committed spend per-dedicated-pool and soft-limit that gracefully degrades to rate-limiting rather than hard failures. Also require per-customer budget alerts.

camille: I'll fold these into the PRD draft and push for review. Target sign-off by Tue EOD. Anyone object to that timeline?

maria: No objections — I'll review the edge-case eval sets and check the hallucination tests.

arjun: I'll push the SLO table + throughput calc into the PR and add the autoscale knobs.

ops-bot: Reminder: Q2 launch checklist item created — https://internal.redwood/boards/DED-PRD-432 (assigned camille, arjun, maria).

camille: Thanks everyone — tagging this for formal review once PR is up.
